name: seo-meta-audit
description: Check every page of your website for the basics search engines look at — titles, descriptions, H1 headings, image alt text, language and mobile tags — and fix titles and descriptions right in a table. Lengths are measured the way results are shown (Chinese characters count double), duplicates across pages are caught, and a search-result preview shows how a page will look. Save fixed copies, or apply the changes to the pages with backups and one-click undo. Runs locally on your files; no SEO service or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 检查网站每个页面里搜索引擎最看重的基础项——标题、描述、H1 标题、图片 alt 文字、语言和移动端标签，并直接在表格里修改标题和描述。长度按搜索结果的显示宽度计算（中文字符算两个），页面之间重复的标题和描述也会被找出来，还能预览页面在搜索结果里的样子。可以保存修改后的副本，也可以直接改原网页（自动备份，一键撤销）。在本地处理文件，不用 SEO 服务，无需 API 密钥。
